trips.route_note: Take the Amtrak Texas Eagle from Austin to San Marcos station, which takes about an hour; the outlet malls and river are a short taxi or rideshare ride away.

trips.why: The train takes about 46 minutes, the fastest public option, and a short taxi or rideshare covers the last stretch to the outlets and river.
know: Daily train departures aren't listed, so check the Amtrak schedule before you go.
The station is not next to the outlets or river, so plan a short taxi or rideshare from the station.
The drive is about 37 minutes (50 km), so driving is an option if transit timing doesn't suit you.
